info.title: Ecommerce Data API
info.description: Amazon ecommerce data APIs for product research, keyword intelligence, market analytics, sales, reviews, traffic, trademarks, and automation.

post.description: Search products by keyword or exact ASIN list.
Research products with category, sales, price, review, and seller filters.
Retrieve product metadata, pricing, ratings, category, and listing attributes.
Search category nodes and category paths.
Retrieve historical product price, rank, rating, and listing snapshots.
Retrieve paginated product reviews with optional star filters.
Estimate product sales from category and BSR rank.
Retrieve current and historical sales estimates for an ASIN.
Retrieve historical coupon activity for an ASIN.

post.summary: Amazon Product Details with Coupon Trends
post.description: Retrieve product details together with coupon history.
Retrieve sales trend data for an ASIN.
Retrieve comparable product records for an ASIN.
Discover keyword opportunities with demand, competition, and PPC filters.
Research keyword demand, growth, competition, conversion, and PPC metrics.
Retrieve historical research metrics for a keyword.
Retrieve geographic and time-series search interest for a keyword.
Retrieve aggregate traffic keyword statistics for an ASIN.
Retrieve traffic keywords, demand, and rank positions for an ASIN.
Research weekly Amazon Brand Analytics keyword metrics.
Research monthly Amazon Brand Analytics keyword metrics.
Retrieve keyword conversion metrics for an Amazon keyword.
Retrieve the keywords that generate orders for ASINs.
Expand traffic keywords from an ASIN list with market filters.
Retrieve weekly or monthly ABA trend data for a keyword.
Retrieve aggregate related-product traffic statistics for an ASIN.
Retrieve related products and traffic positions for ASINs.
Retrieve traffic source composition for an ASIN or keyword.
Research category markets with demand, competition, seller, and margin filters.
Retrieve summary statistics for an Amazon category market.
Measure product concentration within an Amazon category.
Measure brand concentration within an Amazon category.
Measure seller concentration within an Amazon category.
Retrieve fulfillment and seller-type distribution for a category.
Retrieve seller-country distribution for a category.
Retrieve category-level product demand trends.
Retrieve listing-age distribution for a category.
Retrieve listing growth and launch trends for a category.
Retrieve ratings-count distribution for a category.
Retrieve star-rating distribution for a category.
Retrieve product price distribution for a category.
Retrieve A+ content and video adoption distribution for a category.
Retrieve aggregate trademark statistics by office and query text.
Search trademark records across supported intellectual property offices.
Retrieve a trademark record by office and identifier.
List supported trademark offices and countries.
Recognize Chinese or Latin text from an image URL, base64 input, or uploaded file.

items.description: List of Amazon Standard Identification Numbers.

asins.description: List of Amazon Standard Identification Numbers.

match_type.description: Keyword match mode: phrase matches the whole phrase, broad matches any of its words, exact matches the title. Defaults to phrase.

include_variations.description: Include variations. See the documented default in the example column.

availableMonth.description: Limit products by listing age: 1, 3, 6, 12, or 24 months. Omit the field for no listing-age restriction.

badgeAC.description: Set to Y to require an Amazon's Choice badge.

badgeBS.description: Set to Y to require a Best Seller badge.

badgeNR.description: Set to Y to require a New Release badge.

dimensionType.description: Comma-separated product size-tier codes. Codes vary by marketplace; for example US values include ST, LS, SO, MO, LO, SP, O, ELO, EL5O, EL7O, and EL15O. Available values (Table 1.4): United States: ST, SS, LS, SO, MO, LO, LB, SP, O, ELO, EL5O, EL7O, EL15O; Japan: SM, ST, OV, SS, O; Canada: EN, ST, SO, MO, LO, SP, O; Europe (UK/DE/FR/IT/ES): SL, NL, LL, ELL, SM, SD, SB, NB, LB, SPO, O

excludeBrands.description: Exclude products from the specified brand filter.

excludeKeywords.description: Keywords to exclude from the product results.

excludeSellers.description: Exclude products matching the specified seller filter.

filterSub.description: Set to Y to apply the subcategory-rank filters. It only takes effect when a category is specified.

fulfillment.description: Fulfillment types separated by commas. Supported values are AMZ, FBA, and FBM.

includeBrands.description: Only include products from the specified brand filter.

includeSellers.description: Only include products matching the specified seller filter.

keyword.description: Product keyword used to filter listing titles and related text.

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace code. Supported values: US, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, MX, CA, AU, JP, IN, AE, and BR.

matchType.description: Keyword match mode: 1 for phrase match, 2 for broad match, or 3 for exact match. Defaults to 2.

maxAmzUnit.description: Maximum recent sales estimate for the current ASIN. This filter is available for latest-30-day queries.

maxBsr.description: Worst boundary for the top-level Best Sellers Rank. Smaller BSR values indicate a better rank.

maxBsrCr.description: Maximum BSR change rate as a percentage value.

maxBsrCv.description: Maximum numeric BSR change for the selected month.

maxFba.description: Maximum estimated FBA fee in the marketplace currency.

maxPrice.description: Maximum product price in the marketplace currency.

maxRatingsCv.description: Maximum number of newly added ratings in the selected month.

maxRevenue.description: Maximum estimated monthly revenue in the marketplace currency.

maxRevenueCr.description: Maximum monthly revenue growth rate as a percentage value.

maxSellers.description: Maximum number of sellers on the listing.

maxUnits.description: Maximum estimated monthly sales for the parent listing.

maxUnitsCr.description: Maximum monthly sales growth rate as a percentage value.

maxWeights.description: Maximum product weight expressed in weightUnit.

minAmzUnit.description: Minimum recent sales estimate for the current ASIN. This filter is available for latest-30-day queries.

minBsr.description: Best boundary for the top-level Best Sellers Rank. Smaller BSR values indicate a better rank.

minBsrCr.description: Minimum BSR change rate as a percentage value.

minBsrCv.description: Minimum numeric BSR change for the selected month.

minFba.description: Minimum estimated FBA fee in the marketplace currency.

minPrice.description: Minimum product price in the marketplace currency.

minRatingsCv.description: Minimum number of newly added ratings in the selected month.

minRevenue.description: Minimum estimated monthly revenue in the marketplace currency.

minSellers.description: Minimum number of sellers on the listing.

minUnits.description: Minimum estimated monthly sales for the parent listing.

minUnitsCr.description: Minimum monthly sales growth rate as a percentage value.

minWeights.description: Minimum product weight expressed in weightUnit.

month.description: Data month. Use "nearly" for the latest 30 days or yyyyMM for a specific month within the previous 24 months. Available values (Table 1.1): nearly, yyyyMM

nodeIdPath.description: Single Amazon category node path. Use the category endpoint to obtain a node path.

nodeIdPathEqual.description: When true, match only the exact category path. When false, include its descendant categories. Defaults to false.

nodeIdPaths.description: Amazon category node paths. Use the category endpoint to obtain node paths.

field.description: Sort field: total_units, total_amount, bsr_rank, price, rating, reviews, profit, reviews_rate, available_date, or questions. Defaults to total_units. Available values (Table 1.6): total_units, total_amount, bsr_rank, price, rating, reviews, profit, reviews_rate, available_date, questions, total_units_growth, total_amount_growth, reviews_increasement, bsr_rank_cv, bsr_rank_cr, amz_unit

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Defaults to 1. A query can return at most 2,000 records; narrow the filters to retrieve additional segments.

returnFields.description: Optional response-field selection string. Omit it to receive the standard response payload.

sellerNation.description: Seller country or region codes. Multiple values can be separated by commas; common values include CN, HK, US, JP, DE, and FR. Available values (Table 1.5): CN, HK, US, JP, DE, FR

size.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50 and supports up to 100.

variation.description: Variation handling: N includes variation ASINs; Y excludes variation ASINs.

weightUnit.description: Unit used by minWeights and maxWeights: g, kg, oz, or lb. Defaults to g.
